description:
Corin Halbrook has been to the Gate twice this month and turned round both times. Ives would like somebody nearer his own life to walk in with him.

"He isn't frightened of us," she says. "He's frightened of the walk. That's very common and it isn't a character flaw — it's just a distance, and distances are solved by company."

Meet him on Kessler. Walk him west. Nobody is going to ask him to sign anything today, and Ives is quite clear that if you tell him otherwise she'll hear about it.

fail_on.desc: You lost them on the road. Maresh will say nothing about it, at length.

name: A Warm Lead

objectives.desc: Meet Corin Halbrook on Kessler Street.
emotes: {who} finds a man standing outside a shut shop with a folded paper he has stopped reading.
{who} listens to him say he's only having a look, twice, without being asked.
{who} hears him mention his mother's hands, and then apologise for mentioning it.

objectives.desc: Walk Halbrook west to the Gate.
emotes: {who} keeps to his pace, which is slower on the second half of every street.
{who} answers a question about whether it hurts, honestly, and watches him take that badly and keep walking.
{who} gets him to the plate, where he stops, and then steps on it himself.
